confidence_explanation: The timeline shows a clear progression from a brute-force attempt to a successful unauthorized login, followed by privilege escalation, cross-departmental bulk data exfiltration, and log tampering to hide tracks.

attack_chain.description: Brute-force attempt via multiple failed login attempts from an unusual IP (23.129.64.222) during off-hours.
Successful login achieved from the same unusual IP after multiple failures.
Unauthorized privilege escalation to an admin role.
Unauthorized access and download of files from the engineering department, which is outside the user's normal directory scope.
Bulk exfiltration of sensitive files across multiple departments including legal, finance, and marketing.
Anti-forensic activity: deletion/truncation of the authentication log to conceal the intrusion.

gaps: Verification of whether user_08's credentials were stolen or if this was a malicious insider.
Confirmation of the destination of the downloaded files to confirm exfiltration.
narrative: An attacker successfully compromised user_08's account after a brute-force attempt from an external IP. Once logged in, the attacker escalated privileges to admin, performed a bulk download of sensitive files across the engineering, finance, legal, and marketing departments, and finally attempted to cover their tracks by deleting authentication logs.
